title: Core Types of POV
use_cases: Use when crafting intimate or personal stories that require limited character knowledge
Implement when a broad perspective involving multiple characters' internal insights is necessary
Configure when focusing narrative detail on a single character's internal thoughts and feelings
Use when experimenting with reader immediacy through direct address
content:
| Type | Description | Typical Usage | First‑Person (I) | Narrator uses “I” or “we.” | Intimate, personal stories; limited knowledge. | Second‑Person (You) | Direct address to reader. | Rare, experimental; creates immediacy. | Third‑Person Limited | Narrator follows one character’s thoughts/feelings. | Balanced detail with focus on a single viewpoint. | Third‑Person Omniscient | All‑knowing narrator. | Broad perspective, multiple characters’ insights. |
